idea-plugin.name: Backstage Catalog Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Draws a Backstage catalog-info.yaml as the catalog graph it describes.

Open any catalog-info.yaml and a Backstage Catalog view appears beside the source. Every entity in the file becomes a node, and every spec reference (owner, system, dependsOn, providesApis, consumesApis, subcomponentOf, parent, and the rest) becomes a labelled edge, coloured by relation.

References that leave the file — a group owned by another repository, a system defined in the org catalog — are drawn as dashed placeholder nodes, so the picture shows both what the file defines and what it assumes exists elsewhere.

  • Live update as you type, and two-way sync: the caret selects the entity under it, and clicking an entity selects its YAML
  • Owners as badges, Group by System, and Focus on Selection to cut a large file down
  • An outline of the catalog, and Find (Ctrl/Cmd+F) by title or reference
  • Keyboard navigation, zoom, pan and fit
  • Descriptor problems listed and clickable instead of an empty graph

Read-only, scoped to the one file, and never touches the network.
